summary: P1b WS-5 Core foundation: add Alembic managed-block utility and PathGuard project-root writable-file allowlist hook for host context files.
designIntent: P1b starts with Core producer work so Plugin/host consumers can later write short host context managed blocks safely without bypassing PathGuard or duplicating marker logic.

targetTasks.summary: Read AGENTS.md, the state root, and Design/docs/current/alembic-proactive-activation-2026-07-03.md §10.5/§10.6 before editing. Implement only the Core side of WS-5: a reusable managed-block utility that can upsert and remove an Alembic-managed guidance block without touching bytes outside the begin/end markers, plus a PathGuard root-file allowlist hook such as addProjectWritableFile(name) so consumers can explicitly permit CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md without weakening other root-file protection. Do not edit AlembicPlugin or Alembic main in this task; do not wire refreshKnowledgeSkills here; do not change freeze/string values outside the new managed-block markers. Acceptance evidence: raw file list and commit hash; unit tests proving idempotent upsert, replacement, append, remove no-op, remove preserving surrounding content, malformed/nested marker handling if applicable, and PathGuard still rejects unrelated root files while allowing only configured names; build/check commands; risks and next consumer contract for Plugin.
